description: This Java class implements a Vert.x-based MQTT protocol adapter for Eclipse Hono, facilitating message publication to Hono's Telemetry and Event APIs over MQTT. It extends an abstract adapter class and overrides key methods for message handling and topic mapping, including QoS validation.

classes.name: VertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter
classes.description: A concrete implementation of an MQTT protocol adapter for Hono, handling publishing and topic mapping with QoS validation.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the protocol type name supported by this adapter, which is MQTT.

methods.name: onPublishedMessage
methods.description: Handles the process when a message is published, including topic mapping, address validation, message uploading, and error handling.

methods.name: mapTopic
methods.description: Maps the MQTT topic to a resource identifier with QoS validation based on the endpoint type, rejecting unsupported QoS levels.
